fields.Attention and buyer conversion: Hero earns attention; docs, build/contact and social links provide next steps. No dominant token purchase route observed; conversion outcome Unknown.
fields.Participation and return value: Developers can explore docs, ecosystem chains, applications and news without purchasing. Building and monitoring applications is a plausible repeat loop; operation not tested.
fields.Trust and free choice: Team profiles, use-case links and a live-chain-data link support investigation. Displayed performance and fundraising numbers remain project claims.
fields.Unknowns and untested behavior: Measured performance, adoption metrics, mobile/reduced-motion behavior and product functionality untested.
fields.Counterevidence or what would change the: Potential throughput is not measured production throughput; evidence disproving claims would reduce the professional credibility judgment.
